lines.text: Plastic cups are a one-night stand. Ten minutes, then the bin.
Vietnam dumps 3.1 million tonnes of plastic every year.
It's not that we don't care. It's just a hassle.
By twenty thirty, single-use plastics are out. Campuses need a habit that sticks.
Meet One Cup. Reuse, made easy.
Pick your tag: NFC tags, QR cups, lanyards and straps.
Register it in the app, then attach it to any tumbler.
Order, tap the reader, and you're checked in, with a discount.
Every check-in stacks your cup: points, streaks, milestones.
See your community, earn rewards, and watch your impact grow.
Every reuse is verified at the counter, and never counted twice.
Live data for the campus: proof, not promises.
Campuses subscribe, brands sponsor, students buy the gear.
Over half a million new students a year. Any cup, every outlet.
If one in ten new students joins: eight million cups a year.
From awareness to habit, with the cup you already own.
And it's real: the app, the counter and the console already work.
Profit and impact grow together, from campuses to cafés, offices and Southeast Asia.
Because your bottle is a relationship.
One Cup. Your cup, no drama.
